page.layout: One page of running text, one column, with a running head at top left and the page number at top right. No margin notes, no notes below the text, no catchword or signature.

main_text.p: ris & Liberorum divortio proximus certe (imo major in nonnullis) dolor, cùm ab his plus forsan humanis affectibus indulgeatur[?] in praesens, Illi in Gratiae Caelestis incrementum profint.
Hoc Me solatur, quod his Mediis Ordina-rius necessariò destitutos solet Deus Donis suis & Gratiâ extraordinario quodam modo supplere.
Si Me Spiritus illius erudire & infirmitates meas (quod spero) adjuvare voluerit orantis, legentis, meditantis, haud jam alio Oratore aut Doctore opus.

Ad Te igitur, Deus Meus, has jam Preces meas solitarias dirigo: quod alienae opis deest per immediatam tui Spiritus assistentiam supple, qui & tenebras meas solum illustrare potest, & excitare torporem.

O Tu Sol Iustitiae Sacer Fons Caelestis Lucis & Ardoris, Clarifica cor meum & accende, docens Me simul, & pro Me intercedens. In Te Omnis Plenitudo, A Te Omnis abundantia; Per Te Omnis acceptatio, Tu mihi in societatem, in solatium sufficis. Tu Rex meus es, esto mihi & Propheta, & Sacerdos Regas Me, erudias Me, pro Me precare, & mihi semper praesens sis.

Valuit olim in Te colluctatio Jacob in illo Sacro duello, cùm nemo esset praeter Te qui assisteret. Tu Illum roborc[?] donasti quo Te vincere, & grata quadam violentia benedictionem à Te ex-torquerct.

page.notes: Printed text at the very top-left edge is a fragment ("ris") that continues from the previous page. The page number reads "213" with a worn 3. The Greek running head is set in capitals; the letters were read from the scan and may differ slightly in the Σ/Ι forms. "indulgeatur" appears with a c-like e and is doubtful. "roborc" is a probable misprint for "robore" and is copied as printed. Italic and roman distinctions in the long paragraphs are approximate. The large initial "Ad" and "Valuit" are copied as plain letters. Bleed-through from the facing page and faint digitiser text at the bottom right were left out.
